61: func (db *database) init() error {
62: 	if _, err := db.conn.Exec("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON"); err != nil {
63: 		return fmt.Errorf("enable foreign keys: %w", err)
64: 	}
65: 
66: 	schema := fmt.Sprintf(`
67: 	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
68: 		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
69: 		device_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
70: 		has_completed_first_run BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
71: 		expose BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
72: 		survey BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
73: 		browser BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
74: 		models TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
75: 		agent BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
76: 		tools BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
77: 		working_dir TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
78: 		context_length INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
79: 		window_width INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
80: 		window_height INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
81: 		config_migrated BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
82: 		airplane_mode BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
83: 		turbo_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
84: 		websearch_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
85: 		selected_model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
86: 		sidebar_open BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
87: 		last_home_view TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'launch',
88: 		think_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
89: 		think_level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
90: 		cloud_setting_migrated BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
91: 		remote TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', -- deprecated
92: 		auto_update_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
93: 		auto_approve_tools BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
94: 		schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT %d
95: 	);
96: 
97: 	-- Insert default settings row if it doesn't exist
98: 	INSERT OR IGNORE INTO settings (id) VALUES (1);
99: 
100: 	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chats (
101: 		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
102: 		title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
103: 		created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
104: 		browser_state TEXT
105: 	);
106: 
107: 	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
108: 		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
109: 		chat_id TEXT NOT NULL,
110: 		role TEXT NOT NULL,
111: 		content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
112: 		thinking TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
113: 		stream BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
114: 		model_name TEXT,
115: 		model_cloud BOOLEAN, -- deprecated
116: 		model_ollama_host BOOLEAN, -- deprecated
117: 		created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
118: 		updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
119: 		thinking_time_start TIMESTAMP,
120: 		thinking_time_end TIMESTAMP,
121: 		tool_result TEXT,
122: 		FOREIGN KEY (chat_id) REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
123: 	);
124: 
125: 	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_chat_id ON messages(chat_id);
126: 
127: 	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tool_calls (
128: 		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
129: 		message_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
130: 		type TEXT NOT NULL,
131: 		function_name TEXT NOT NULL,
132: 		function_arguments TEXT NOT NULL,
133: 		function_result TEXT,
134: 		FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
135: 	);
136: 
137: 	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tool_calls_message_id ON tool_calls(message_id);
138: 
139: 	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attachments (
140: 		id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
141: 		message_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
142: 		filename TEXT NOT NULL,
143: 		data BLOB NOT NULL,
144: 		FOREIGN KEY (message_id) REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
145: 	);
146: 
147: 	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attachments_message_id ON attachments(message_id);
148: 
149: 	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
150: 		name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
151: 		email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
152: 		plan TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
153: 		cached_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
154: 	);
155: 	`, currentSchemaVersion)
156: 
157: 	_, err := db.conn.Exec(schema)
158: 	if err != nil {
159: 		return err
160: 	}
161: 
162: 	// Check and upgrade schema version if needed
163: 	if err := db.migrate(); err != nil {
164: 		return fmt.Errorf("migrate schema: %w", err)
165: 	}
166: 
167: 	// Clean up orphaned records created before foreign key constraints were properly enforced
168: 	// TODO: Can eventually be removed - cleans up data from foreign key bug (ollama/ollama#11785, ollama/app#476)
169: 	if err := db.cleanupOrphanedData(); err != nil {
170: 		return fmt.Errorf("cleanup orphaned data: %w", err)
171: 	}
172: 
173: 	return nil
174: }
